purpose: Read-only reconciliation of all Excel feature-inventory rows against the finalized native Microsoft Excel corpus and the two pre-finalization residual audits. This record identifies true remaining native authoring gaps, bounded subscopes, UI limitations, package-only families, external handoffs, and library boundaries without changing source code or coverage metadata.

provenance.producer: Microsoft Office Excel fixtures authored and reopened by the root agent Computer Use session; this audit did not operate Office UI.
provenance.platform_assumption: The native UI observations are session-scoped to the available macOS Excel build. Cross-platform commands are not inferred.

scope.stale_category_note: The coverage residual categories and residual audit labels predate the final metadata, revisions, and legacy MacroSheet fixtures. They are retained as provenance only; the disjoint reconciled groups below supersede their old genuinely_missing/unknown labels.

finalized_native_groups.bounded_scope: 17 embedded chart families, chart sheets/resources, caches, source formulas, and native reopen; rendering and complete chart authoring remain library boundaries.
Native connection/query metadata and saved package records; no refresh, network, credentials, or provider execution.
Native ordinary, array/CSE, shared/dynamic, data-table, scenario and cached formula-owner records; no library recalculation or execution claim.
Native 1904 date system, cached serial/date values, hidden rows/columns, custom views, print metadata and manual breaks; no print/rendering runtime claim.
Eleven native worksheet Form Controls, linked values and inert drawing/VML/control properties; no ActiveX/VBA/control execution.
Native data bars, color scales, icon sets, formula rule, duplicate rule and picture/shape drawing anchors; no rendering parity claim.
Native pivot caches/views/charts, sparklines, filters/sorts/outlines and chart relationships as recorded by the inspection.
Native Region/Product slicers, Date timeline selection and PivotChart saved-state controls; XLS conversion loss is recorded in the inspection.
Native links, OLE/embedded objects and picture/drawing relationships as explicitly bounded by the inspection.

Rich runs, ignored errors, cell watch, classic note, background/header-footer pictures, consolidation and exact raw BIFF12/BIFF8 metadata; XLSB high-level timeout and XLS sheet enumeration are reader boundaries.
Native revision headers/logs/user records and six deterministic edits; typed readers expose final cells/caches, not revision semantics or coauthoring.
Real inert MacroSheet authored by Ctrl+F11 in XLSM/XLSB/XLS; the dialog-sheet sub-scope remains intentionally unclaimed.

remaining_native_open_subscopes.evidence_required: Fresh native save, native reopen without repair, exact package/BIFF payload inspection, and typed reader boundary probes for only the newly created sub-scope.
remaining_native_open_subscopes.do_not_duplicate: Do not create another operation-only fixture for formula, cache, metadata, or ordinary note behavior already covered by the finalized corpus.

non_gui_or_external_family_decisions.reason: Future/unknown records require a producer/version or raw native source; they are not a user-authorable Excel UI family.
The source APIs expose bounded payload/package owners, but no direct local Excel authoring route was observed and arbitrary application semantics are not inferred.
XCB is an inert legacy toolbar metadata stream with reader/writer APIs; no current native workbook UI route was observed for creating a controlled XCB payload.

non_gui_or_external_family_decisions.family: Volatile dependencies (xlsx-208 is the compound calculation-chain/volatile row)
non_gui_or_external_family_decisions.reason: These are generated/inert dependency metadata with no UI authoring workflow, refresh, evaluator, network, RTD or cube semantics. The XLSB matrix explicitly says native coverage is synthetic.

external_handoff_decisions.reason: Requires a human-controlled password/encryption handoff; no password is recorded here.
Requires a certificate/private-key identity and trust context; no deterministic local UI fixture is claimed.

external_handoff_decisions.family: RTD/DDE/OLE/MDX, survey, add-in, task-pane, web-extension and custom Ribbon/provider behavior
external_handoff_decisions.reason: Depends on an external provider, service, identity, manifest or executable host behavior. Saved inert metadata is not equivalent to a native runtime fixture.

genuinely_missing_authorable_families.basis: After the finalized metadata, revisions and MacroSheet records, every remaining pending row either has operation-only semantics, a bounded native sub-scope, a directly observed session UI limitation, a package/spec boundary, an external handoff, or an explicit library boundary. No pending row currently has both a concrete local native UI route and no finalized fixture.

unknown_rows_and_routes.coverage_matrix_unknown_note: The current coverage residual_matrix_pending_categories.unknown bucket contains no Excel row IDs; its generic “unknown” mapping in the older audits represented the old genuinely-missing labels.
unknown_rows_and_routes.interpretation: These are route-unknown or UI-limited subscopes, not evidence that a local Excel writer should synthesize package bytes.

Classifies the dialog relationship in tab-state snapshots.
Requires application/vnd.ms-excel.dialogsheet and Transitional/Strict dialog relationships, then maps SheetKind::Dialog.
Keeps dialog-sheet relationships in the known non-worksheet package graph.
Recognizes the XLSB dialog-sheet content type in embedded-part inventory.

phonetic_and_threaded.evidence: Typed phoneticPr parser criteria exist, but parser support does not prove native Excel UI authorability.
BIFF8 phonetic synthesis is unsupported; classic notes exist while modern threaded comments are outside the XLS model.

Threaded and phonetic metadata owners are typed, while collaboration/rendering are deliberately inactive.

package_only_families.evidence: Unknown/future BIFF, Custom XML and XCB are bounded opaque/package metadata families; their writer/read APIs do not establish a native Excel UI route.
Volatile dependencies and XML maps are inert metadata; mapped XML import/export and Custom XML processing are explicitly outside the library/runtime.
Volatile dependencies, XML maps and Custom XML stores have bounded package models but no host service or native UI behavior claim.
